observations: Piray 2026 CAUSE remains an arXiv preprint first posted 2026-05-19. The public abstract states that volatility increases optimal exploration while observation stochasticity decreases it, and that CAUSE is a closed-form control-as-inference exploration index for restless Gaussian state-space bandits.

A current public review of the paper exposes the probit constant phi=pi/8, the backward-precision recursion, and the reported CAUSE index structure used here only as a source-derived bounded implementation. This run did not obtain author simulation code.

Fresh web/GitHub searches for the exact title, arXiv 2605.19215 and Payam Piray + CAUSE found the paper, lab profile, mirrors and unrelated repositories but no clear author CAUSE repository or independent execution. Non-discovery is not evidence of absence.
PLOS SPLiT S1 Code.zip remains publicly linked at DOI 10.1371/journal.pcbi.1014719.s002, but the current read-only transport still did not yield the ZIP payload/file tree.
public_source_update.code_replication_status: No clear author CAUSE reference implementation or independent CAUSE rerun located in this run; SPLiT source-exact code audit remains blocked by ZIP transport.

bounded_audit.scope: Two source-derived synthetic audits. Neither is an exact reproduction of CAUSE, Piray-Daw 2024, SPLiT, PAST/GROUSE, or any predecessor controller. The first is a sequential two-component AR decomposition with a discrete Bayesian parameter posterior; the second is a restless Gaussian bandit with per-arm four-state Bayesian source inference and the published CAUSE structural index approximated from public formula descriptions.

event_level_source_filter.model: z_t=x_t+e_t; x_t=a*x_{t-1}+eta_t and e_t=rho*e_{t-1}+xi_t. Q and S denote stationary component variances, with innovation variances Q*(1-a^2) and S*(1-rho^2). A 24-hypothesis online Kalman model grid covers a in {0.78,0.82,0.86}, rho in {0.2,0.6,0.78,0.82}, and (Q,S) in {(0.8,0.2),(0.2,0.8)}. A semantic prior concentrates a near 0.82 while rho remains broad; hazard mixing 0.002 permits source-regime changes.
event_level_source_filter.abstention_gate: Act on source identity only when max posterior P(Q>S) or P(S>Q) >=0.99 and posterior E|a-rho|>=0.25; otherwise abstain. The stricter threshold is inside the zero-confident-error region on disjoint calibration and was chosen to protect held-out source-swap streams.
event_level_source_filter.interpretation: A genuine sequential posterior can turn the a≈rho symmetry from confident reversal into explicit abstention, but zero-confident-error safety is expensive: only about one quarter of separated held-out samples are actionable and detection lags by ~51 samples. When rho≈a, the correct behavior is total abstention because second-order source identity remains effectively unresolvable.

partial_observation_cause_probe.published_structure_used: lambda_CAUSE = m + c*(P+v)*alpha_tilde with c=0.5, phi=pi/8, alpha_tilde derived from a public closed-form summary; gamma=0.95 and alpha_hat=1/(1-gamma) were used in this bounded implementation. This is not author code.
partial_observation_cause_probe.environment: K=4 restless Gaussian random-walk arms, T=250. Only the selected arm is observed; all latent arm states drift every step. True matched source states are one random permutation of v in {0.01,0.20} x s in {0.25,4.0}. Each arm maintains a four-hypothesis Bayesian Kalman posterior.
partial_observation_cause_probe.semantic_gate_calibration: On disjoint round-robin calibration (300 seeds, T=240), require posterior mass >=0.995 on the one-sided volatility-dominant or stochasticity-dominant state; this had zero confident semantic reversals among calibrated decisions, with 36.72% coverage of eligible one-sided-arm updates. Otherwise use shared/base v=sqrt(0.01*0.20) and s=sqrt(0.25*4.0).

mechanistic_interpretation.positive: Under action-dependent partial observations, a calibrated source-abstention gate prevents the large regret cost of forced MAP source assignment in the matched family and remains much safer than forced attribution under intermediate Gaussian, Student-t and skewed observation models.
mechanistic_interpretation.negative_boundary: Cause-aware specificity did not beat the always-shared/base fallback in these held-out regimes; their paired regret differences include zero. Thus the immediate value is safety against reversed exploration, not yet positive marginal value from fine source attribution. Moreover, skew misspecification breaks the zero-confident-error guarantee (2.77% of confident selected-arm decisions were semantically reversed), showing that posterior confidence inside a misspecified Gaussian family is not a valid identifiability certificate.
mechanistic_interpretation.decision: Do not connect this posterior to dormant-memory restore yet. Require a model-misspecification/identifiability layer that detects non-Gaussian or otherwise out-of-family residual structure and restores the confident-error guarantee without destroying change latency; then require cause-aware posterior control to beat shared fallback in at least one predeclared held-out regime.

limits: The CAUSE implementation is source-derived from public formula descriptions, not author code, and uses pseudo-regret rather than the paper's exact discounted metric.
The event-level AR filter uses a discrete model grid and an informative semantic prior; a≈rho remains nonidentifiable and is intentionally abstained.
The bandit filter's matched four-state grid exactly contains the matched true source states, so the strongest safety result is not evidence of arbitrary-model robustness.

The misspecification stress covers intermediate Gaussian, Student-t5 and centered-lognormal skew only; correlated burst, scale drift and composite non-Gaussian families remain to be integrated online.
No genuine PAST/GROUSE or SPLiT execution occurred.
bounded_audit.exact_next_action: Continue read-only SPLiT S1 Code.zip recovery without mutation and CAUSE author-code/independent-rerun search. Replace posterior confidence as the identifiability certificate with an online posterior-predictive model-checking layer: maintain a Gaussian source model plus at least Student-t, skewed and correlated-burst alternatives, and abstain whenever out-of-family evidence is material. Calibrate on disjoint families, then test unseen mixtures/scale drift so the gate is not family-locked. Re-run the same action-dependent partial-observation bandit with predeclared matched and misspecified regimes, comparing forced MAP, posterior BMA, semantic abstention, always-shared/base, regime-only and oracle. Require (1) zero or statistically bounded near-zero confident semantic reversals under held-out misspecification, (2) acceptable source-change latency, and (3) a statistically resolved regret gain over always-shared/base in at least one regime before connecting the posterior to a genuine O(Nk) PAST/GROUSE-style dormant-memory tracker with weak/delayed semantic cues. Preserve complete abstention in a≈rho label-symmetric regimes, exact tested scope, CLEAN isolation, and a nonempty frontier.
